# Copilot Instructions

Before making any change in this repository, read and follow the root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and the focused guides under [`agents/`](../agents/).

Do not invent a separate file layout, schema, naming convention, or research workflow. In particular:

- search for an existing canonical model before creating one;
- keep ThinkPad and ThinkCentre records in their documented namespaces;
- preserve source provenance for substantive specifications;
- prefer official IBM/Lenovo sources;
- mark uncertainty/conflicts instead of guessing;
- update coverage/index files with canonical record changes;
- follow `agents/VALIDATION.md` before considering work complete.
